name: smwmusic-snailiad-iris
title: Snailiad - Iris
description:
The song that plays in the Temple of Iris from the flash game Snailiad.

This is my first port, so I thought I'd do something simple and not insanely difficult. Also, I haven't seen a single song from Snailiad ported yet, which is a shame because the music from Snailiad is pretty good.

UPDATE: 3/9/19 at 5:03 PM - Made the port sound more like the original.
UPDATE 2: 3/10/19 at 9:40 AM - Optimized file and also fixed channel 2 audio
